goal: Allow spending Taproot outputs using key paths only, skipping script-path population and signing
Prevents fee waste and privacy leaks from exposing fallback scripts in setups like MuSig2
Avoids hardware signer bugs triggered when signing script paths alongside key paths
agreement: Strong support with substantive feedback on RPC scope and test coverage addressed (rkrux)
Verified by testing fallback skipping and PSBT key-path signing (jeanpablojp)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it avoids premature script exposure and extra transaction fees for complex Taproot setups
Workarounds hardware wallet signing bugs triggered by signing script paths alongside key paths
